question: Starting only when a market-wide STOP has actually fired, can recovery rules reopen MTS causally without knowledge of the future trough?
state_machine: while LOCKED evaluate recovery rule every session
score subsequent path retrospectively only after declaration
start_rule: Each test begins on the actual causal STOP declaration date supplied by the relevant frozen/descriptive stop episode. No trough date may initialize, reset, or gate a candidate.

H1_OFF.rule: Group C 4-of-4 >=90th-percentile stress condition absent for 3 consecutive sessions

H2_50.rule: all four Group C percentile ranks <0.50 for 3 sessions

H2_60.rule: all four Group C percentile ranks <0.60 for 3 sessions

H2_70.rule: all four Group C percentile ranks <0.70 for 3 sessions

H2_80.rule: all four Group C percentile ranks <0.80 for 3 sessions

2008.stop_source: heldout-2008 Path-B descriptor rule; diagnostic only, not frozen Group C

primary_scope: 2022 is the valid frozen Group-C STOP/reentry pairing. 2008 is included only as a secondary recovery-mechanism diagnostic because Group C is not the 2008 stop.
false_reentry: If declaration occurs before the reference trough, it is presumptively premature; additionally report whether within 60 sessions it makes a new lower market level than at declaration and/or suffers >=10% drawdown from declaration.
durability: After declaration, report 60-session max drawdown and whether a lower market level occurs. Reference trough is used only for retrospective scoring.
qualification: Current-S&P broad-market panel survivorship qualification applies.
